basis: Not written by the delivered scripts, which run as `python -I -B file.py`. A script started that way never reads __pycache__, -I leaves its folder off sys.path, and nothing imports these modules. Git ignores __pycache__. No host needs these files, so leave them out of any transfer; if one arrives, nothing reads it. Their writer wasn't identified, and a later syntax check can rewrite them, so their hashes here are observations, not gates. A compiled file records this machine's source path, so it would fail the path scan that every sealed file passes. It is outside the seal, and git ignores it.
